reason: Connect the methane transfer line to its store to begin filling the fuel tank.
expectation: I expect a methane line connected to the store, ready to transfer to the lander.

alternatives.reason: The oxygen system also needs connecting; I chose methane first arbitrarily.

effect: The methane line and store form an assembly, so I can now connect it to the tank.
reaction: The result is straightforward and matches my expectation.
reason: Complete the methane transfer while its assembly is ready.
expectation: The lander methane tank will be filled from the store.

alternatives.reason: I could prepare the oxygen assembly first, but prefer completing one line at a time.

effect: The methane tank is fueled; the oxygen system remains.
reaction: A satisfying concrete milestone, though predictable.
reason: Prepare the oxygen transfer assembly; it is the only gameplay option and the other tank still needs filling.
expectation: The certified line and oxygen store form an oxygen transfer assembly.

effect: The oxygen assembly is ready to connect, as expected.
reaction: This repeats the methane preparation without adding much interest.
reason: Fill the remaining oxygen tank using the only gameplay option.
expectation: The oxygen tank will be filled and the goal completed.

effect: The oxygen tank is fueled too, completing the chapter goal.
reaction: The completion is reassuring but unsurprising after the methane sequence.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the methane tank was the clearest payoff: it made a concrete step toward getting home after the long fuel-production history.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing and filling the oxygen line repeated the methane sequence with little new detail, so it felt routine.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; each result followed its labeled components.

arbitrary.text: The actions had clear purposes, although choosing which line to prepare first felt arbitrary because both were required.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the frozen discovery gets home, though this chapter alone offered little exploration or new understanding.
